You can unsubscribe at any time. More info Thank you for subscribing Korean skincare has been one of the biggest trends in beauty for the last few years, and for good reason. The products often combine high-tech and natural ingredients to create beautiful, clear 'glass-like skin'.
 With so much innovation coming out of the country, it comes as to no surprise that British brands have jumped on the hype. Last year, No7 brought out its Good Intent range, focusing on science-backed ingredients rivalling the likes of Laneige and other popular Korean brands. 
 Now, No7 has extended the range with beautiful gift sets for Christmas 2026. Included is the No7 Good Intent Hydration Heroes set , available for £29.50 instead of £60 as part of Boots' weekly Star Gift range that sees products from bestselling brands reduced by 50% for a limited time.
 READ MORE: Boots reduces £84 makeup gift set with eight full-sized products to just £35 
 READ MORE: Marks and Spencer shoppers discover hack to get £20 autumn pamper gift for £3 
 The No7 Good Intent Hydration Heroes set features seven products, five of which are full-sized. To put it another way, each item works out to cost £4.28 apiece, which is much cheaper than if you were to buy them individually.
 The set includes a hydrating cleansing balm to remove makeup and impurities, skin-clarifying toner pads, a hydrating moisturiser, the viral skin sip moisture milk, and a radiance-boosting spray serum. The gift also includes wash cuffs to keep your arms dry. Everything comes wrapped in a Good Intent bag, making it easy to keep your routine organised.
 The star product in the set is arguably the Intent Dew Bank Water Cream , worth £14.95. The lightweight, fast-absorbing water cream helps support and recharge the skin's natural moisture barrier, leaving it silky soft.
 The No7 Good Intent Hydration Heroes set costs £29.50 but is worth £60 (Image: Boots)

 It features a quenching cocktail of hyaluronic acid and camellia oil to deliver an instant hit of hydration. The cream also rehydrates skin and protects against dryness, for an instantly dewy complexion.
 Another is the Pore Buff Clarifying Acid Pads , also valued at £14.95. Infused with salicylic acid, glycolic acid and lactic acid, the pore pads are designed to buff away pore-clogging oil and impurities with a gentle, refreshing exfoliation.
 Here's everything found inside the No7 Good Intent Hydration Heroes set: 
 Good Intent Wash Cuffs 
 Good Intent Bag Full Size 
 Good Intent Glow Grind Cleansing Balm 43g 
 Good Intent Pore Buff Clarifying Acid Pads 80 Pads - full size 
 Good Intent Dew Bank Water Cream 100ml - full size 
 Good Intent Skin Sip Moisture Glaze Milk 150ml - full size 
 Good Intent Radiance Reflect Spray Serum 90ml - full size 
 The gift set contains seven products, five of which are full-sized (Image: Boots) 
 Elsewhere, Ole's Icons Skincare Set by Ole Henriksen, worth £84, is available at LookFantastic for £52. The trio features three skincare essentials designed to promote a radiant, hydrated complexion and visibly plumped lips. 
 The curated collection uses gold-complexed vitamin C and peptides to leave your skin looking smooth and effortlessly glowy. It includes the iconic Banana Bright+ Eye Crème to target dark circles, the Strength Trainer Peptide Boost Moisturiser for intensive nourishment, and a Pout Preserve Peptide Lip Treatment.
 Alternatively, Tatcha's Dewy Skin To Go Set , worth £93, costs £65 at Space NK. set includes a travel pouch and three essential products that work harmoniously to cleanse, nourish, and moisturise your skin with ease.
 The Good Intent Dew Bank Water Cream (Image: Boots) 
 The set includes a mini bottle of The Rice Wash, a gentle, pH-neutral cream cleanser that transforms into a rich foam with water to cleanse, clarify, and soften skin while boosting hydration. It also features The Dewy Serum and The Dewy Milk Moisturiser to provide an all-day dewy glow and boosts skin bounce.
 Back at Boots, the No7 Good Intent Hydration Heroes set is yet to receive any reviews from shoppers. The Good Intent Dew Bank Water Cream, on the other hand, boasts an overall star-rating of 4.6 out of five based on 111 reviews, available to buy here individually for £14.95.

 One satisfied shopper said: " I enjoy this product. Similar to Laneige products where it absorbs well and keeps my skin hydrated. My skin is smooth and looks glowy."
 The Good Intent Glow Grind Cleansing Balm (Image: Boots) 
 A second wrote: "I've been trying the No7 Good Intent Water Cream and I honestly love it. The texture is ultra-lightweight, like a water gel, and it absorbs instantly without leaving your skin feeling greasy or heavy. It leaves your skin feeling super refreshed with that pretty, healthy glow."
 "It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly," a third penned. "It’s not sticky at all and perfect for everyday use. I love layering this with my skincare. 
 "It doesn’t give greasy or oily finish and it’s perfect since I have combination skin. It feels hydrating and such a good moisturizer for everyday."
 The Good Intent Pore Buff Clarifying Acid Pads (Image: Boots) 
 One shopper, however, wasn't as impressed with the Good Intent Dew Bank Water Cream , giving it a three-star review. They shared: "I used this for about 6 weeks in the UK heatwave, it’s good it’s like a gel-crème texture. 
 "So it’s lightweight, and semi-matte but if you have dry skin it’s not as hydrating as you may need it to be. Under makeup it’s really good though. So, I would use again in the summer if I’m wearing makeup."
 "Not too keen on this," a two-star review mentions. "I've been using it for over a month and feel it hasn’t done much for my skin. It’s a bit too light for me and i don't feel that my skin has been its best since using it. Won’t be repurchasing."
 The Good Intent Skin Sip Moisture Glaze Milk (Image: Boots) 
 Show more 
 Nevertheless, someone else loved their latest No7 Good Intent purchase , adding: "This cream has the dreamiest, lightweight texture that instantly cools and refreshes the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. It sinks right in, leaving my face so soft, bouncy, and deeply moisturized all day long. 
 "It also wears wonderfully under makeup—no pilling or extra shine. If your skin needs a fresh, weightless moisture boost, you'll love this."
 Another five-star review reads: "I have purchased this three times so far, it’s my favourite moisturiser to use everyday. It just sinks into my skin and gives a lovely glow. The bottle lasts me around four to five months."
